title: Ssaddaaka Ey’Okwetegefu
intro: Mu kiseera eky’okugezesebwa okw’obwakatonda, emmeeme yayitibwa okugenda mu kikolwa ekisembayo eky’okugondera. Omuntu ono yakuzibwa mu nsi etaliimu bimera, yakula n’alaga okukkiriza n’obugumiikiriza. Okwolesebwa bwe kwalagira okuwaayo ssaddaaka, tebaawugukanga. Emboozi yaabwe jjinja lya nsonda mu kwewaayo.
clues: Nze nali eky’okuddamu mu ssaala ya nnabbi omukulu eyali emaze ebbanga nga tulindiriddwa.
Nze ne maama twasigala mu kiwonvu ekyali kifuuse amatongo nga tulina eby’okulya byokka eby’ensukusa n’amazzi.
Nakula ne nfuuka nnabbi amanyiddwa olw’amazima n’obugumiikiriza.
Nayamba taata okusitula emisingi gy’ennyumba entukuvu eyaweebwayo eri Allah.
Taata bwe yang’amba ekirooto eky’okunsaddaaka, nnamuddamu nti, ‘Kola nga bw’olagiddwa.’
Allah yassa ekitiibwa mu kugondera kwange bwe yasindika endiga ennume okuva mu bbanga okununula.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yaggyibwa mu nnyanja ekika kya whale

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
